name: Ian Jolovich
occupation: Platte County commissioner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)

background: Ian Jolovich is a Platte County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. He won the November 2022 general election, and the official commissioners page lists him as a member. Incoming commissioner Kayla Mantle takes office in January 2027.
